OneLineDescription: Tags armor with Advanced Nudity Detection keywords from existing SLA_ keywords, gated by OCF child/uniform exclusions.
LongDescription: Translates existing SLA_ (SexLab Aroused) keywords on armor into matching AND_ (Advanced Nudity Detection) keywords via a slot-aware mapping table, leaving the original SLA_ keyword in place so the armor ends up carrying both. OCF (Object Categorization Framework) keywords are used only as a safety gate, not as a mapping source: armor tagged as OCF child clothing or quest/uniform disguises is skipped entirely regardless of any SLA_ keyword it carries. Armor flagged OCF_ArmorMainSkimpy that still ends up with no AND_/SLA_ coverage is listed at the end of the run as a candidate for the companion KID backup file.
